subject: SpICE status: eval battery reproduced, realistic speech is the hard part
body:
Hi Goran, Ivo,

Status.

Eval battery: reproduced on schedule in April. Our serving-wrapped model matches the published generalization numbers - TORGO at 100%, UASpeech correlation 0.93, ALS-TDI PMP 0.81 AUC - so Milan's wrapper isn't distorting anything.

Realistic speech is where it gets honest. On our unprompted-speech validation set (built to mirror the ~2,300-sample realistic set from the release, with dysarthric and control speakers), exact five-class agreement drops meaningfully versus prompted utterances - most confusion is between adjacent classes, mild vs moderate especially. Within-one-class agreement stays above 95%, which clinicians tell us is the operationally meaningful bar.

Recommendation: the API reports the predicted class plus an adjacent-class confidence band rather than a bare 0-4 score. Emeka has a mock partners liked.

Risk: pooled-corpus retraining configs need to freeze by May 29 for the June run. Any eval-battery change after that waits for the next cycle.

Linnea
